digest.component_or_area: enrich gate marker and queue drain path
propositions: A single pending entry in the queue disables the O(1) fast path for the entire store, causing subsequent writes to incur full O(store) scans (~1.2s at 4,938 tickets) rather than the cached O(1) path (~0.11ms)
The gate marker's all-or-nothing write strategy (only written when scan finds nothing pending) means one eligible entry blocks marker creation indefinitely, forcing repeated store-wide walks

The marker should generalize from 'whole store is quiet' to 'everything outside a recorded live set is quiet', allowing O(backlog) scoped walks instead of O(store) full scans when a non-empty pending set exists
A standing non-empty pending set must not pay a full store walk cost on every write; drain operations should scale with backlog depth, not total store size
